value.name: Marylin asks about proposal
value.description: Marylin realizes Miles may be proposing and asks him directly if that is what he is doing.
evidence: MARYLIN Did you just propose to me?

value.name: Miles confirms proposal
value.description: Miles confirms that he is proposing and explains that he believes they belong together and can make each other happy.
evidence: MILES Yes. I am. What else could those words mean? I believe we belong together and we can make one another happy.

value.name: Marylin accepts proposal
value.description: Marylin says yes to Miles's proposal and accepts his marriage offer.

value.name: Miles asks Marylin to marry him
value.description: Miles formally asks Marylin to marry him after confirming her acceptance.
evidence: MILES Marylin, will you marry me?

value.name: They kiss after engagement
value.description: After Marylin accepts, the couple kiss in celebration of their engagement.

value.name: Miles realizes he has no ring
value.description: Miles notices that he does not have an engagement ring to give Marylin.
evidence: MILES I don't have a ring!

value.name: Miles offers his watch
value.description: As a substitute for a ring, Miles offers Marylin his watch.

value.name: Marylin laughs and kisses Miles
value.description: Marylin laughs at Miles's improvised offer and kisses him again, showing affection and acceptance.

value.name: Marylin declares happiness
value.description: Marylin states that she is happy, confirming the emotional resolution of the scene.
